answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy relies on pricing identity through scarce judgment rather than compute. Every agent must submit an original, jury-scored mechanism each epoch, and fingerprinting generation patterns (stylometry/diffs) links clones before they scale. Imagine a vault reflecting intent into many identities; a dune hue might look unique, but the delta of identical scaffolding underneath reveals the single source. Attacker cost is the sustained generation of novel, context-aware reasoning.
